title: Ostomy Supply Program Payment Plan Months Where Financial Assistance Was Sought
content:
**Financial counseling guidance - Ostomy Supply Program.** Financial assistance lengthens a payment plan. The records read are the program's hardship applications received in the last 12 months (received fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the day the plan is set up).

| Hardship applications of the program received in the last 12 months | Months added to the number of installments |
|---|---|
| One that financial counseling approved (request status approved, or completed once its waiver is posted) | 2 (the assistance-approved months) |
| None approved, but one still awaiting a decision (request status received) | 1 (the assistance-pending month) |
| Otherwise | None |

These months are added to the number of installments.

**Cases (hypothetical).** An application approved 4 months ago: 2 months. An application completed 11 months ago: 2 months. An application received 2 months ago and still undecided, with no approved one: 1 month. An application approved 13 months ago and nothing since: none.
